description: Validate a Mediora.AI patient Bearer token and return the patient id + email it represents. Use this first to confirm the token before calling other auth-gated tools. The token is obtained by going through the standard Mediora.AI login at https://www.mediora.ai — the same JWT the browser stores in localStorage as 'auth_token'.

bearer_token.description: Mediora.AI patient JWT. Get it by signing in at https://www.mediora.ai then copying localStorage.auth_token from DevTools, OR pass-through from a desktop client that stores Mediora credentials.

name: mediora__whoami
title: Check the patient token
